text:
diane: Quick thread for OrbitAI onboarding — partner is asking for a three-way SKU split (hosted, partner-hosted proxy, gated download) + escrowed decryption keys for enterprise customers. Need legal/export/ops alignment.
omar: Escrowed keys = partner provides encrypted weights + escrow key held by 3rd-party custodian? What's our risk profile here?
neil: Operationally we can support key escrow if partner supplies a KMS-wrapped envelope per customer. We'll need an attestation flow and a documented recovery workflow. Also need to know if downloads are full-weights or quantized subsets.
partner-orbit: We propose: hosted tile (redwood-hosted), partner-proxy (we host model, Redwood proxies), and gated-download (customers sign MSA + escrow key option). For gated downloads we can provide FP16 and INT8-qt bundles. We'll sign artifacts with cosign and provide OpenKey v4 provenance.
legal-bot: Marketplace policy reminder: downloadable SKUs require explicit redistribution flag: "no-download", "download-restricted", or "download-sublicensable". For escrowed keys we need clear custody docs and an escrow agreement. Also export classification for NL origin required.
diane: Partner asked whether escrow increases our compliance burden (export / sanctions). Legal?
legal-bot: Escrow introduces additional controls. Export-control needs the escrow custodian to be in an approved jurisdiction and to maintain audit logs. I'll open ticket EX-8044 to validate jurisdictions and get a recommended escrow template.
omar: For the tile metadata we should add fields: "download_flag", "escrow_supported", "escrow_custodian_url", "supported_quantizations", "sri_weights", "container_digest". Example snippet:```
{
  "model": "OrbitAI-9B",
  "version": "2026-09-01",
  "download_flag": "download-restricted",
  "escrow_supported": "true",
  "escrow_custodian_url": "https://escrow.example.com/OrbitAI",
  "supported_quantizations": ["fp16","int8-qt"],
  "sri_weights": "sha256-Base64:...",
  "container_digest": "sha256:..."
}```
neil: Telemetry: partner insists on aggregated-only counters and hashed model version IDs. For escrowed downloads they require no telemetry beyond license checkouts. That complicates billing — how do we audit downloads for rev-share?
legal-bot: For downloads we can rely on entitlement records + partner invoices. Finance will require monthly reconciliation and an audit clause where Redwood can request attestation under NDA. We'll include that in the appendix.
partner-orbit: For SI-managed installs, we want a 70/30 partner/redwood rev-share; downloadable SKU we propose 60/40, hosted 85/15. We are open to alternate splits tied to support SLAs.
diane: Finance will need a reporting format. Neil, can ops produce a per-SKU monthly summary (counts, regions, revenue buckets) without raw telemetry?
neil: Yes — we can produce aggregated counters and region binned totals. For partner-hosted proxy we can require signed billing webhooks and periodic reconciliations.
omar: Security: signed manifests must include SLSA provenance or equivalent. For escrow flows we need an offline verification step in the install docs. Also require PGP signature on the manifest and cosign sig on containers.
partner-orbit: We'll provide SLSA build traces, OpenKey v4 signatures, and insurance binder. We can also support a short takedown SLA and limited warranty language.
legal-bot: Limited warranty acceptable if partner supplies E&O + cyber insurance meeting our thresholds. I'll open PL ticket PL-8045 for indemnity & rev-share appendix review. Need insurer binder attached.
diane: Marketing wants co-announcement and a model card public summary. Partner requests a 10-business-day embargo after contract signoff. They also want to review any quote and logo usage.
partner-orbit: We'll approve marketing assets within 48h of receiving drafts. Embargo of 10 business days is acceptable.
neil: Ops timeline proposal:
- Today: collect signed artifacts (manifest.sig, cosign sig, SLSA traces)
- Thu: legal + export initial review (PL-8045 / EX-8044)
- Fri: ops create staging tile, block downloadable SKU until legal clears
- Two weeks after partner signoff: publish + co-announce per embargo
ops-bot: I'll create staging tile and set downloadable SKU to blocked by default. I'll also add canary routing for partner-proxy and a billing webhook integration.
legal-bot: Filed EX-8044 (escrow jurisdiction check) and PL-8045 (indemnity/rev-share). Target responses by Fri 17:00 UTC.
diane: Action item recap:
- @partner-orbit: upload cosign signatures, manifest.pgp, SLSA traces, and insurer binder by Wed EOD
- @legal-bot: review indemnity + rev-share + escrow template by Fri EOD
- @ops-bot: create staging tile, gate downloadable SKU, enable proxy canary
- @neil: draft entitlement/audit format for finance reconciliation
If blockers appear, flag here and well escalate. Thanks all! :handshake:
